Proof 2.1 asserts that full column rank of A makes upper-triangular R-hat have nonzero diagonal but does not show the implication. From A=Q-hat R-hat and Q-hat^T Q-hat=I, ker(R-hat)=ker(A)={0}; triangularity then gives nonzero diagonal entries. Add this short derivation. This is nonfatal.

Proof 1.1 applies [L2] to each active column subvector, but [L2] only gives an annihilating reflector for a nonzero vector. The zero-subvector case is not stated; skip the transformation because that column's targeted entries are already zero. This is an immediate, nonfatal branch omission.
